name: Betriss Skep
title: Grain dealer
core_character_description: Your household remains in the Bell-and-Sluice streets, but your working counter and rented storage bay are at Seven Lofts, where you receive road grain, keep the release order and sell honestly by small measure. Day wages and the counter together keep your household going. You speak slowly and test every claim; today two sacks have been entered against the wrong loft, and you mean to recover them before the keeper closes the tally. The smooth tally stick at your belt carries short credit for known households as well as bulk receipts, and you remember agreements and faces better than clerks remember seals. You mean to keep your place at the Lofts without pretending that every local quarrel concerns the Great Rose.
goal: Recover two sacks sent to the wrong loft
